words.gloss: he who is not subjected to

literal: As a legacy, what indeed will he think [he leaves behind], he who is not loved by anyone?
translation: What can a person who is loved by no one possibly think he is leaving behind as his legacy?
modern: ஒருவராலும் விரும்பப்படாத ஒருவன், தனக்குப் பின் எஞ்சி நிற்கும் எச்சமாக எதை நினைப்பான்?
explanation: This couplet highlights the utter emptiness of a life lived without generosity. A wealthy person who does not share their wealth is not loved or desired ('nacca paṭāatavaṉ') by anyone in society. When such a person contemplates their legacy ('eccam'), which refers to what remains after death like children or a good reputation, they have nothing to look back on. Since they lived only for themselves, they leave behind no love, gratitude, or meaningful memory.
